topics.name: Universal Module Dependency Closure
topics.purpose: Define deterministic dependency closure across Universal Modules with explicit required/optional edges, compatibility checks and no auto-enable semantics.

semantics.edge_rule: Dependency edges are explicit and typed required/optional.
semantics.closure_rule: Closure is deterministic over exact module identities/versions.
semantics.cycle_rule: Dependency cycles are rejected or handled by explicit compatible cycle semantics.
semantics.enable_rule: Dependency presence never auto-enables a module.
semantics.missing_rule: Missing required dependency hard-fails activation/validation unless explicitly pruned by supported semantics.
semantics.order_rule: Filesystem/load order does not define dependency precedence.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
